confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on crowd-sourced Numbeo data (November 2026 Abu Dhabi update, cross-checked with Expatistan) and travel-guide price ranges from search results, not verified menus. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal are the firmest. Cocktail and wine-glass values are midpoints of guide ranges, checked against the beer anchor, because no aggregated per-drink figure was found. Mid-range two-person pricing sits above Numbeo's median because Expatistan's dinner-for-two benchmark (which includes wine and dessert) implies a higher food-only cost. Service charge and VAT treatment is unclear. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge with a July low-season adjustment. No accommodation searches or live listing checks were made, and hostel values are least certain. The FX observation (2026-11-18) is the latest RBA figure found. It comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page rather than the F11.1 table, and no later 2026-11-19 figure was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparison city was used. Food and drink anchors are Abu Dhabi-specific. Accommodation anchors use a general UAE capital hotel-tier basis from model knowledge. The dirham is pegged to the US dollar.
